instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert a single row with product_id='John'
output: INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) VALUES ('John', 100);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert multiple rows at once
output: INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) VALUES ('John', 1), ('Jane', 2), ('Jim', 3);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert into orders from a select that filters status
output: INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) SELECT product_id, qty FROM orders_src WHERE status = 'x';

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update the row with id=7
output: UPDATE orders SET product_id = 'NewName' WHERE id = 7;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update all rows setting qty to 0
output: UPDATE orders SET qty = 0;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update orders increasing all qty by 10%
output: UPDATE orders SET qty = qty * 1.1;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update rows where status equals 'done'
output: UPDATE orders SET product_id = 'Finished' WHERE status = 'done';

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete a row by id 12
output: DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = 12;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete rows where qty is below 50
output: DELETE FROM orders WHERE qty < 50;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete rows where status is NULL
output: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete all rows from orders
output: DELETE FROM orders;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Upsert: insert or update on conflict of the id
output: INSERT INTO orders (id, product_id) VALUES (1, 'X') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET product_id = EXCLUDED.product_id;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Conditional update using CASE
output: UPDATE orders SET qty = CASE WHEN qty > 100 THEN qty - 10 ELSE qty + 10 END;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update a join-based target using a subquery value
output: UPDATE orders SET qty = (SELECT MAX(qty) FROM orders) WHERE qty IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete with a subquery filter
output: DELETE FROM orders WHERE qty IN (SELECT qty FROM orders WHERE status = 'skip');

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert with explicit column list and defaults
output: INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty, status) VALUES ('A', 5, 'active');

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update with a LIMIT to only change a few rows
output: UPDATE orders SET qty = qty + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM orders LIMIT 5);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert ignoring duplicates
output: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO orders (product_id) VALUES ('Dup');

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Delete a range where qty between two values
output: DELETE FROM orders WHERE qty BETWEEN 20 AND 30;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Update setting multiple columns
output: UPDATE orders SET product_id = 'Z', qty = 0, status = NULL WHERE id = 9;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Insert a row returning its id
output: INSERT INTO orders (product_id) VALUES ('Ret') RETURNING id;

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Replace all occurrences in a string column
output: UPDATE orders SET status = REPLACE(status, 'a', 'b');

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Trim whitespace then update product_id
output: UPDATE orders SET product_id = TRIM(product_id);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Lowercase a text column in place
output: UPDATE orders SET product_id = LOWER(product_id);

instruction:
Schema: orders(id, product_id, qty, status)
Bulk upsert with multiple rows
output: INSERT INTO orders (id, product_id) VALUES (1, 'A'), (2, 'B') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET product_id = EXCLUDED.product_id;
